pr_title: fix(rust, python) Summation on empty series evaluates to `Some(0)`
pr_body:
Closes: #5604 

Changes:
* Calling `Series::sum()` on an empty series now evaluates to `Some(0)`.
* Calling `Series::sum_as_series()` on an empty series now returns a Series with a single zero'd value. This is done to enable the above change in both Rust and Python libraries.
* Adjusted documentation to reflect this change.
* Added two unit tests to Python tests: `test_arithmetic_empty `, `test_arithmetic_null `.

----
I chose to add logic directly to `sum_as_series()` as to reduce the blast radius of this new logic. Please let me know if any changes are needed, including location of tests!
pr_comments: From https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/blob/master/py-polars/src/series.rs#L482 , it looks like I'll need to adjust `sum_as_series` instead of base `sum` in order to have these changes reflect in the Python library. I've adjusted the PR to reflect this change

issue_context.title: Empty `Series` sum to `None`
issue_context.body:
### Issue description

The sum of an empty collection should be the neutral element for the addition operation. This behaviour is implemented in pure rust (e.g. `Vec`), in Python, numpy, torch, etc.

### Reproducible example

```
let v: Vec<i32> = vec![];
assert_eq!(Series::from_vec("", v).sum::<i32>(), None)
```

### Expected behavior

```
let v: Vec<i32> = vec![];
assert_eq!(Series::from_vec("", v).sum::<i32>(), 0_i32)
```

### Installed versions

Latest
